responsibility: Declares shared helper interfaces for GIMPLE/SSA access diagnostics, including checks for unterminated arrays and nonstring arguments, generic bound and access validation entry points, and the warning helpers used by warning passes such as gimple-ssa-warn-access and gimple-ssa-warn-restrict.
same_name_distinction: Shared declarations header for access-warning helpers, meant to be included by warning passes such as gimple-ssa-warn-access and gimple-ssa-warn-restrict; unlike gcc/gimple-ssa-warn-access.cc, it does not define the pass or perform statement traversal itself.
